children: LB Pharmaceuticals has hired Joseph Miller as the neuromedicines company's new chief financial officer.
LB on Thursday said Miller, 52 years old, most recently served as finance chief of Aurinia Pharmaceuticals.
The New York company said Miller will receive an initial annual base salary of $530,000 and an annual bonus with a target of 40% of his base pay.
